clips.title: The story
paras: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon pursues the Royal Apothecary Society's grim mandate to engineer lethal concoctions against the living. To advance his morbid experiments, he enlists travelers to harvest animal reagents from the surrounding foothills.

While Tarren Mill serves as a military stronghold for the Forsaken in the Hillsbrad Foothills, it also functions as an active research station for the Royal Apothecary Society. Stationed amidst the scenic greenery, Apothecary Lydon despises the pristine countryside and yearns to see the human settlements poisoned and conquered. To manufacture his experimental 'Elixir of Suffering', he requires local biological agents known for their potency and virulence.

Developing alchemical plagues demands precise ingredients. Lydon directs hunters into the wilds surrounding Tarren Mill to collect the tongues of native Gray Bears alongside rare ichor secreted by Moss Creepers. Once refined through unholy alchemy, these organic fluids form the foundation for a lethal mixture intended to eradicate living trespassers across Hillsbrad.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, another wretched day in Tarren Mill. All of this clean air puts me in such a foul mood, friend.
The sooner we can plague the humans here, the better. I've been conducting intense studies on possible killing agents to use in my concoctions but I haven't the time to collect them all.

If you want to make yourself of use, procure the following items for me: 10 Gray Bear Tongues and the very rare and hard to find, Creeper Ichor. You'll find both bears and creepers just outside of Tarren Mill.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I see you are back. I hope you were able to gather the agents I need. Another deathless day will put me in such a gloomy mood.

clips.title: Completion
paras: These specimens are perfect. Well, friend, you have managed to bring me the slightest hint of joy on yet another miserable day. Your efforts are appreciated.
